title.orig: Rue Eugène Moussoir at Moret: Winter
title.en: Rue Eugène Moussoir at Moret: Winter
title.zh: 莫雷的欧仁-穆苏瓦街：冬

image.edit: Trimmed the dark photographic background around the object, then resized.

basis.en: Public domain: the artist died in 1899. The Metropolitan Museum of Art releases this image under CC0 through its Open Access programme.
basis.zh: 公有领域：作者卒于 1899 年。大都会艺术博物馆通过开放获取计划以 CC0 发布此图像。

alt.en: A small-town street in winter: banks of snow along a road that curves away between pale houses and a long wall, a few figures walking in the distance, bare trees at the right, and a soft lilac-grey sky.
alt.zh: 冬天的小镇街道：一条路在浅色房屋和一道长墙之间弯向远处，路边堆着雪，远处有几个行人，右边是落尽叶子的树，天空是柔和的淡紫灰。

note.en: Sisley spent his last years in Moret-sur-Loing and painted its streets and river in every season. Snow was one of the Impressionists' favourite tests, because white is never just white: here it is blue in shadow, pink near the walls and grey under the sky. Nothing dramatic happens, only a cold afternoon in a small town.
note.zh: 西斯莱晚年住在卢万河畔莫雷，把这里的街道和河流在每个季节都画过。雪是印象派最爱的考题之一，因为白从来不只是白：这里它在阴影里是蓝的，靠墙处泛粉，天空下发灰。没有任何戏剧性的事发生，只是小镇上一个寒冷的下午。
